test_has_context: test the has_context method to check if a code object has an associated context
create_get_context: create a call to get_context that returns or initializes a context dict for a code object
build_pop_context: build a call to pop_context that retrieves and removes the context for a code object
test_clear: test the clear method to remove all stored code contexts
review_code_context: review the CodeContextDict class and its weak-key dictionary management for code objects
